output.headline: General Atlantic: provider-focused growth investor paying a 16.5x median, with 13 of 14 deals closed, and a size range that fits a $200M Midwest target.
output.differentiator: General Atlantic pays a 16.5x median, second only to Blackstone on the priority list, and has the best closing rate among the sponsors on it: 13 of 14 deals.
output.why_them: Provider-focused growth investor; pays upper-quartile multiples, closes deals

acquirer_overview.title: General Atlantic: growth equity firm with a 14-deal, provider-weighted record since 2019
points: General Atlantic is a growth equity firm investing across Technology, Consumer, Financial Services, Healthcare and Life Sciences; AUM US$125.3 billion [P:1, P:2].
14 deals from 2019 to 2024, 13 closed (93%), all control deals rather than minority stakes [T:record, K:closed_share, K:control_share].
Provider services account for 9 of 14 deals; Physician Groups is its largest sub-sector with 4 deals [A:angles, K:by_sub_sector].

strategic_fit_thesis.title: Provider specialist with the right size, but no open platform
points: Deals in this or neighbouring sub-sectors and its closing record are modest positive factors in General Atlantic's likelihood [S:sector_rel, S:close_rate_s].
Revenue synergies (Market Share) drove 5 of 14 deals, against 19% of deals across the file: a distinct share-gain motive [M:market_share].
Angles are provider specialist and size fit; no open platform, so the target would be a stand-alone investment [A:angles].

precedent_activity.title: Closest precedents: Oak Health at 18.8x and Crest Medical Practice at 11.5x
points: Oak Health (Healthcare Services, $1,708M, Merger of Equals, 2021) at 18.8x EBITDA, its one deal in the target's own sub-sector [D:MA-2021-0066].
Crest Medical Practice (Physician Groups, $121M, Leveraged Buyout, 2023) at 11.5x, inside the comparable size band [D:MA-2023-0499, K:size_band].
Harbor Home Health Partners ($15M, Midwest Strategic Acquisition, 2022) at 16.9x shows regional reach [D:MA-2022-0273].

valuation_context.title: 75th percentile is defensible, but returns at $200M need a platform exit
points: Comps (70 deals): 12.8x median, 15.3x at the 75th percentile; the target's 16.8% margin versus the 12.9% comps median supports the 75th [V:comps].
General Atlantic's own 16.5x median paid is above the comps' 75th percentile, so it has paid above the range [T:record, V:comps].
IRR at the ask is 18.7% versus a 20% target; maximum price is $193M at the same exit, $216M at a 15.0x platform exit [V:lbo].

risk_flags.title: Return at the asking price
risk_flags.concern: IRR at the ask of 18.7% is below the 20% target [V:lbo].
risk_flags.mitigant: A platform exit at 15.0x lifts the maximum price to $216M [V:lbo].
risk_flags.reality: The bid works only with a platform exit, and it has no open platform [V:lbo, A:angles].

risk_flags.title: Thin record in the target's sub-sector
risk_flags.concern: Only 1 deal in the target's own sub-sector; that share is a slight factor against [T:record, S:sector_share].
risk_flags.mitigant: 8 deals in adjacent provider sub-sectors, 4 in Physician Groups [T:record, K:by_sub_sector].
risk_flags.reality: Provider fit is real, but the Healthcare Services record is a single 2021 deal [D:MA-2021-0066].

risk_flags.title: Execution and regional depth
risk_flags.concern: Frontier Clinics ($7M, 2021) was terminated, and only 2 deals were in the Midwest [D:MA-2021-0337, T:record].
risk_flags.reality: Closing risk looks low; Midwest depth is limited [K:closed_share, T:record].

conviction.rationale: 1 deal in the target's own sub-sector and 8 in adjacent provider sub-sectors support fit, but there is no open platform in the sub-sector, which is neutral [C:conviction].
